name: 02339 · Hanover, MA
findings: ZIP 02339 (Hanover) has 85 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (19%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02339 (Hanover) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02339 (Hanover) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).
